warnings.head: FIRST CATEGORY WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS
warnings.text: SECTION A: FOR MALAYSIAN WATERS [WITHIN 24 NAUTICAL MILES] 1) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Perlis & Kedah • Penang • Perak • Selangor • East Johor • Pahang • Terengganu • Kelantan • Western Sarawak • Western Sabah until 8:00 PM; Friday, 27 November 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats. warnings.head: THUNDERSTORMS WARNING
warnings.text: Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the states of Perlis • Kedah • Penang • Perak • Kelantan (Gua Musang) • Pahang (Rompin, Pekan, Kuantan, Jerantut and Maran) • Selangor (Sabak Bernam, Hulu Selangor, Hulu Langat and Gombak) • Negeri Sembilan (Kuala Pilah, Tampin, Rembau, Seremban and Jelebu) • Melaka • Johor (Kluang, Mersing, Kota Tinggi, Kulai and Johor Bahru) • Sabah: West Coast (Penampang, Putatan, Kota Kinabalu, Papar and Tuaran), Interior (Beaufort and Tambunan) until 6:00 PM; Friday, 27 November 2026.
warnings.title: Thunderstorms Warning

warnings.head: CONTINUOUS RAIN WARNING (ALERT)
warnings.text: Continuous rain is expected to occur over the states of Kelantan (Pasir Puteh, Bachok, Kota Bharu, Tumpat, Pasir Mas, Machang, Tanah Merah, Jeli and Kuala Krai) • Terengganu until Sunday, 29 November 2026.
